description: An animated glowing progress bar built on the SVG substrate — the fill draws left-to-right with a gradient + soft glow halo, an optional label, and a percentage that counts up with the fill. The KPI-charging-up move a flat div can't express. First asset authored natively on src/svg/.

label.description: Optional caption rendered above the bar

trackFill.description: raw hex for the unfilled track (NOT a color token — must be a hex literal)

glowStrength.description: glow blur stdDeviation in px; 0 disables halo

gradient.description: raw hex literals for the gradient fill
